engineering_model.temperature: Temperature-dependent strength, modulus, conductivity, expansion and oxidation must be retained.
engineering_model.time: Creep, stress relaxation and microstructural evolution require time-at-temperature.
engineering_model.environment: Atmosphere can govern oxidation, corrosion and coating behaviour.
engineering_model.processing: Heat treatment, grain structure and manufacturing route can dominate high-temperature performance.

rule: No universal maximum service temperature is assigned to a material family.
